basic_info.description: Modern 4BR home, redesigned and expanded in 2015 by Rossington Architects.  A bright, open plan with clean lines and functional living/entertaining spaces supports ideal circulation throughout.  The heart of the home includes a striking double parlor, sumptuous living room with wood-burning fireplace that frames a City view, elegant formal dining with ample space to host large dinner parties, and a chic powder room.  Custom walnut detailing balances natural, warm accents with the contemporary interiors. At the rear of the plan is a breath-taking chef's kitchen and great room / family room that is an entertainer's dream!  Southern orientation and large windows and doors create the ultimate indoor/outdoor flow to a broad deck and lush, mature gardens. The sky-lit upper floor includes 3BR/2BR, with dramatic primary suite, cathedral ceilings, a wall of south-facing windows, and laundry.  Downstairs are three rooms that are smartly laid out to offer flexible living - a generous media den, bright office and 4th bedroom can be used as formal rooms, or opened up to suit a more family-friendly flow.  Amazing walk/bike location, 94-WalkScore, steps to organic grocer, butcher, and other convenient services/trans. Across the street from Upper Noe Playground, Park and Recreation Center.
